task_sampling: uniform task then molecules; train on every available fitted label in the molecule batch
repeated_smiles_labels: median for regression, mean for noisy binary labels; fit rows only
spearman_loss: fit-only Gaussian-rank targets plus 0.10 pairwise ranking; continuous logits at prediction
validation: Global scaffold and identity separation for all fitted task labels; secondary official valid excludes all query scaffold groups from training
selection_objective: 0.6 historically reused full-ensemble valid gain + 0.4 mean paired CV gain over v24 neural branch - 0.1 CV gain SD
selection_tradeoffs: positive overall task objective required, secondary valid gain >0.0001, CV mean >-0.01 and at least one nonnegative fold; losses in individual CV folds are allowed and reported
limitation: Full historical ensemble OOF unavailable; valid repeatedly reused, score formula unknown, cannot forecast official score
